headline: Car tax: some promised to abolish it and some did. Renzi dusts off a 10-year-old Meloni post, she silences him: "You've discovered the difference between announcing and delivering"
summary: Matteo Renzi revived an old Giorgia Meloni post on the car tax, and she responded that announcing differs from delivering. The abolition has divided the left.
why: Vehicle taxation changes affect Italian household costs and the automotive market.

original_headline: Bollo auto, c’è chi prometteva di abolirlo e chi lo ha fatto. Renzi rispolvera un post di Meloni di 10 anni fa, lei lo zittisce: «Hai scoperto la differenza tra annunciare e realizzare»
